## Description
`Encina.EntityFrameworkCore.BulkOperations.BulkOperationsEF` dispatches to `BulkOperationsEFOracle` and `BulkOperationsEFSqlite`, and its `CreateProviderImplementation` switch references `OracleConnection` and `SqliteConnection`. Oracle was removed pre-1.0 (ADR-009) and SQLite too (ADR-024). This is dead code that keeps references to providers outside the supported matrix.

## Location
`src/Encina.EntityFrameworkCore/BulkOperations/`

## Current Behavior
The `BulkOperationsEF` class includes logic to detect and dispatch to Oracle and SQLite providers, even though these providers are no longer part of the supported matrix. The `CreateProviderImplementation` method contains switch cases for `OracleConnection` and `SqliteConnection`.

## Expected Behavior
The `BulkOperationsEF` class should only dispatch to supported providers: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MySQL. References to Oracle and SQLite should be removed to align with the current provider support matrix.

## Root Cause
The removal of Oracle (ADR-009) and SQLite (ADR-024) providers did not include a complete cleanup of the bulk operations dispatch logic and related implementation classes.

## Proposed Fix
Remove the Oracle and SQLite branches from the `CreateProviderImplementation` switch statement and delete the corresponding implementation classes (`BulkOperationsEFOracle` and `BulkOperationsEFSqlite`) if still present. Retain only the logic for SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MySQL.

## Priority
- [ ] **High** - Must be fixed before release
- [ ] **Medium** - Should be fixed in the current release
- [x] **Low** - Nice to have, can be deferred

## Effort Estimate
- [x] Small (< 1 hour)
- [ ] Medium (1-4 hours)
- [ ] Large (> 4 hours)

## Related Issues
- ADR-009
- ADR-024
- #83

comments.body: Scope note from auditing a draft fix: Oracle and SQLite references in `Encina.EntityFrameworkCore` go well beyond `BulkOperations`. 21 source files still mention them: `src/Encina.EntityFrameworkCore/ABAC/PolicyEntityConfiguration.cs`, `src/Encina.EntityFrameworkCore/ABAC/PolicySetEntityConfiguration.cs`, `src/Encina.EntityFrameworkCore/ABAC/PolicyStoreEF.cs`, `src/Encina.EntityFrameworkCore/Anonymization/TokenMappingStoreEF.cs`, `src/Encina.EntityFrameworkCore/BulkOperations/BulkOperationsEF.cs`, `src/Encina.EntityFrameworkCore/BulkOperations/BulkOperationsEFOracle.cs`, `src/Encina.EntityFrameworkCore/BulkOperations/BulkOperationsEFSqlite.cs`, `src/Encina.EntityFrameworkCore/Caching/SqlTableExtractor.cs`, `src/Encina.EntityFrameworkCore/Configuration/EntityConfigurationExtensions.cs`, `src/Encina.EntityFrameworkCore/Converters/ShardPrefixedIdConverter.cs`, `src/Encina.EntityFrameworkCore/Converters/SnowflakeIdConverter.cs`, `src/Encina.EntityFrameworkCore/Converters/UlidIdConverter.cs`, `src/Encina.EntityFrameworkCore/Converters/UuidV7IdConverter.cs`, `src/Encina.EntityFrameworkCore/ProcessingActivity/ProcessingActivityRegistryEF.cs`, `src/Encina.EntityFrameworkCore/Resilience/EfCoreDatabaseHealthMonitor.cs`, `src/Encina.EntityFrameworkCore/Sharding/Migrations/EfCoreMigrationOptions.cs`, `src/Encina.EntityFrameworkCore/Sharding/FunctionalShardedRepositoryEF.cs`, `src/Encina.EntityFrameworkCore/Sharding/ShardedDbContextFactory.cs`, `src/Encina.EntityFrameworkCore/Sharding/ShardedReadWriteDbContextFactory.cs`, `src/Encina.EntityFrameworkCore/Sharding/ShardingServiceCollectionExtensions.cs`, `src/Encina.EntityFrameworkCore/Encina.EntityFrameworkCore.csproj`. Some may be legitimate, such as provider-name switches that only branch. Others may be dead dispatch like the bulk one. Do not remove the Oracle or SQLite package references from the csproj until every file above has been checked. Removing them only for the bulk classes would break the build.
